scientific_question: How much of the frozen 50-D soft footprint's object value is carried by visible area, position, extent, covariance, or the full 49-cell continuous field?

frozen_upstream.transitive_ledger: The annotated upstream tag transitively freezes the camera contract, natural image-space audit, target-design study, C0-v2, C1-v2.1 candidates and scale, D13/D14/D15, WM-v2A/B/B.1/C-EJ, all matched branches, and all prior reports/results/checkpoints.

calibration.use: all formula checks, missing/stability checks, ridge CV and fitting, and freezing

development_evaluation.use: one-shot frozen development evaluation, not blind confirmation

F0.formula: 49 soft 7x7 occupancy fractions plus exact continuous visible-area fraction

F2.formula: 49 soft 7x7 occupancy fractions without exact area

F7.stability_rule: reject before evaluation if any calibration state is nonfinite or any sigma denominator is not protected by 1e-12

missing_values.visibility: visible area zero is retained as zero
missing_values.centroid_and_moments: never impute zero, image centre, or previous value
missing_values.secondary_visibility_bit: allowed diagnostically but not used by the primary F0-F7 selection

values: centroid displacement or zero when absent
exact-area difference when present, otherwise soft-map mean difference
pair_summary.fairness: all F0-F7 and the frozen B2 diagnostic use the same six slots and the same G baseline
pair_summary.normalization: ridge standardization is fitted only on calibration rows

probes.selection: leave-one-init-state-out CV within init31-34; exact ties favor larger alpha
targets: frozen ObjMask residual after calibration EE-only control
frozen Area residual after calibration EE-only control

shuffle.rule: derange the complete six-dimensional Fk summary across branch points within identical task, horizon, and candidate pair while G and target remain fixed

bootstrap.unit: task-stratified matched branch point retaining all 24 pair/horizon rows

gates.shuffle_rule: relative degradation positive with branch-bootstrap CI lower above zero
gates.complete_target_gate: same raw target clears 10 percent, positive CI, shuffle, 7 tasks, 4 horizons, all 3 pairs; its matched EE-conditioned residual clears 5 percent with positive CI; raw gain retains at least 80 percent of F0
gates.conditional_label_rule: a conditional component adds value only at >=5 percent RMSE improvement with CI lower above zero; otherwise binary is redundant given area

preflight_correction_history.phase: after calibration and before development evaluation
preflight_correction_history.issue: The first implementation mapped SOFT_OCCUPANCY_ADDS_VALUE_BEYOND_AREA to F1->F3 rather than the intended G+area->G+soft-map+area comparison.
preflight_correction_history.correction: Add the missing F1->F0 nested comparison and use it only for the already-preregistered conditional label.
preflight_correction_history.unchanged: F0-F7 formulas, pair summaries, data, ridge forms and grid, targets, residuals, bootstrap draws, shuffles, numeric gates, minimum-dimension rule, partitions, and authorizations

decision.minimum_rule: lowest dimension among candidates with a complete target gate; candidate order breaks exact dimensional ties
